method.explosionSource: Ragefire buff-band expirations from Warcraft Logs Buffs table
method.liveTargetProxy: targets hit by the latest Immolation Aura damage event near the Ragefire expiration, excluding targets already dead; the same-buff-tagged target count is retained as an audit field
method.limitation: Warcraft Logs exposes damage events but not actor coordinates here; a live recent Aura target missing from Ragefire is a positioning/target-state candidate, not definitive proof of distance.
